caveats: Evers isn't seeking re-election. Wisconsin governors hold an unusually broad partial veto over appropriation bills. Odd-numbered Senate districts (17) are up. Seat counts come from NCSL (updated 2026-10-06). Leaders are listed only where confirmed on an official legislature site; others are omitted. Veto thresholds and executive-power descriptions reflect constitutional and statutory structure and weren't individually re-verified against the statutes in this pass.

vetoOverride: Majority of members elected to each house; 2/3 for budget and supplementary appropriation bills
executivePowers: The governor appoints the West Virginia Public Service Commission, which sets the rates and large-load terms that apply to data centers. The governor has some form of line-item veto over appropriations, which can reach incentive funding in budget bills. Economic development recruitment, including data center deals, runs through the West Virginia Department of Economic Development, which is executive-branch controlled or governor-influenced. Data-center-specific executive orders were not reviewed for this record.
